tagline: Self-hosted anime and manga media server with NVIDIA hardware transcoding
description:
Seanime is an open-source media server with a web interface and desktop
app for anime and manga. It integrates with AniList, manages your local
library, streams and downloads episodes, and plays them with your media
player of choice.

This package uses the CUDA image (umagistr/seanime:*-cuda). It runs as
a non-root user (UID 1001) and ships an FFmpeg build with NVENC/NVDEC
for NVIDIA GPUs. It needs an NVIDIA GPU, the NVIDIA driver and the
NVIDIA Container Toolkit on an amd64 host, and uses host port 3214 so
it can run next to the other Seanime variants.
author: restuindrawan

tips.before_install:
NVIDIA NVENC/NVDEC: this variant needs an NVIDIA GPU, the NVIDIA
driver and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit on the Zima box, with the
`nvidia` Docker runtime available. If that runtime is missing, the
container will fail to start. The image's maintainer notes
hardware features could not be tested in CI, so check them on
your own hardware.

Different default UID: the CUDA image runs as UID:GID 1001:1001,
not 1000. An init step fixes ownership of the config and downloads
folders on every start, and never touches your anime files. If
the scan shows an empty library, your media is probably owned by
another user. Run `ls -ln /DATA/Media/Anime`, then set PUID and
PGID to the owner's UID and GID at install.

This app has its own config folder and WebUI port (3214), so it
does not share settings with the other Seanime variants. Do not run
two variants against the same downloads folder at the same time.

Publishing outside your LAN: set a server password first. Seanime's
docs require server.password when the server is reachable from
outside this machine. Set SEANIME_SERVER_PASSWORD during install,
or edit config.toml in the config folder after the first start and
set password under [server], then restart. A password is not
encryption: prefer a VPN such as Tailscale or an HTTPS reverse
proxy over forwarding plain HTTP port 3214 on your router.

title: Seanime (NVIDIA CUDA)
release_note: Add the NVIDIA CUDA Seanime variant, pinned to v3.10.4, on host port 3214 with the nvidia runtime, PUID/PGID (default 1001) and optional SEANIME_SERVER_PASSWORD.
